page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.6xlarge is a KVM-virtualized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. This x86_64 architecture CPU features 12 physical cores and 24 vCPUs with a dedicated allocation, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on external storage options. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark results position the ecs.hfg7.6xlarge in the average performance tier across most compute and memory metrics. The single-core stress-ng performance is recorded at 1576.09, while the multi-core score reaches 24950.58. In memory-intensive tasks, the instance demonstrates a strong PassMark memory score of 2847.06, placing it in the top 25% category. Large-block memory bandwidth reads reach 90.69 GB/sec, and write speeds are measured at 53.33 GB/sec. For database operations, the instance achieves 24.01 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and a PassMark database score of 9340.41.

With its balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated CPU resources, this instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, software compilation, and web serving. It achieves a static web serving throughput of 18.38 GB/sec and a Clang software compilation score of 20775.0. Small-scale language model inference is viable, with prompt processing speeds of 1395.5 tokens per second on a 135M model, though performance drops to 35.61 tokens per second on a 7B model. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration makes it less suitable for large-scale data storage or heavy deep learning workloads.
